participation.context: Left the part, refused a tally, and stayed on this side of the river.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Stayed civil and said he had no line to sell.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Said the bill was walked, that nothing was bought, and named the Rose's afternoon.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

story.body: You finished the part, stayed civil with Kemp, and did not start a tally. You did not go to the Rose.
